steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Real-life graphs: Graphs that represent real-world situations and data. Common types include distance-time graphs, conversion graphs, and filling/emptying containers.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: On a distance-time graph, what does a horizontal line mean? | A car travels 120 miles in 3 hours. What is its speed? | On a speed-time graph, what does the area under the graph represent?
